The Mackie HR624MK2 is a different revision and is not used. Sources: https://www.fullcompass.com/common/files/1648-SRM450TechSpecs.pdf; https://www.manualslib.com/manual/97211/Mackie-Srm-450.html.

notes: Secondary (REPUTABLE_DATABASE): Stereophile 'Totem Acoustic Model 1 loudspeaker Specifications' sidebar (1995). Two-way stand-mounted reflex. Sensitivity is written by the source as '87dB/W/m (2.83V)'; it is stored with the 2.83V/1m reference the source states, not relabelled as 1 W/1 m. Nominal impedance 4 Ω. driverCount 2 = 1.2-inch metal-dome tweeter plus 125 mm woofer. Woofer size not stored: a 2001 Signature review ('Model 1 Signature', 5.5-inch midrange/woofer) describes a different driver, so the revision conflicts and the woofer is not fixed. The Signature version is not merged. Amplifier requirements (15 W minimum, 120 W maximum) are source text but are not stored as a recommended range. Source: https://www.stereophile.com/content/totem-acoustic-model-1-loudspeaker-specifications.
